meta.title: Hartwell & Okafor | Family law, wills and probate in Islington
meta.description: A small Islington law practice for divorce, children arrangements, wills, lasting powers of attorney and probate. Fixed fees where we can. Free 20 minute first call.

rationale: Clients arrive worried and often grieving, so the page is a deep forest green with warm light text and a light serif, quiet and slow, with brass used only where an action or a number matters. Prose columns, principles and a question-and-answer process let the firm explain itself in plain sentences instead of selling. The boldness is kept to three things a worried person cares about: the free 20 minutes as a huge figure, the fee said first as a marked line, and a drawing of the table where the first meeting happens.

props.name: Hartwell & Okafor
props.tagline: Family law, wills and probate, Islington

props.statement: When a marriage ends, a parent dies or a will needs writing, you should be told what it will cost before anything else happens.
props.detail: We are a small practice in Islington: two partners, Clare Hartwell and Tunde Okafor, and a paralegal. Most people ring us on a hard day. We keep the first conversation easy.

props.caption: free first call, to tell us what has happened and what worries you

items.name: Family law
items.description: Divorce, separation and the arrangements for your children: where they live, how time is shared, how money is split. We explain the steps in the order they will happen, so you are not surprised by the next letter.

items.name: Wills and lasting powers of attorney
items.description: A will that says what you mean, and a lasting power of attorney so someone you trust can act for you if you cannot. Both are usually quick to do and much harder to fix later.

items.name: Probate
items.description: Dealing with the estate after someone has died: the paperwork, the forms for the court, the bank accounts and the property. We tell you what must be done now and what can wait.

items.claim: A fixed fee wherever the work allows it.
items.detail: Some matters cannot be priced up front, a contested divorce for one. When that is the case we say so, and say how we will keep you informed of the cost.

items.claim: The first call is free and lasts 20 minutes.
items.detail: You do not need documents, dates or the right words. Tell us what is going on.
You will know who has your file, and you can ring the person who is working on it.

pairs.answer: You tell us what has happened. We tell you what your options are and whether we are the right firm for you. It takes 20 minutes and costs nothing.

pairs.ask: Will I be told what it costs?
pairs.answer: Yes. Where we can offer a fixed fee, we give you the figure in writing before any work starts.

pairs.ask: I am not sure I need a solicitor.
pairs.answer: Then the call is for working that out. Some people finish it knowing they can handle things themselves, and that is a good outcome.
Nothing. If you have a letter or a date in mind, have it near you. If not, we will start from the beginning.
